en: A black-and-white image of a quiet residential street lined with detached houses, each with pitched roofs and garden fences. The street leads to a prominent, large building in the background with a clock tower and ornate façade—likely a town hall or civic building. A single cyclist rides down the center of the street. The area beyond the buildings is rural, with open fields and distant hills.
